desc.en: Blue soil that is also highly viscous. It's commonly used as a pigment, and a material for pottery. There are many theories to explain its coloration, from the color of the lost oceans, to the blueness of the sky.
desc.ja: 青みを帯びた粘性の強い土。顔料や陶器の材料に使われることが多い。失われた海の青さを閉じ込めた、空の青さが落ちてきたなど、その色の由来は諸説ある

desc.en: Causes weapon to enhance attack power. Effect: Increases attack power by 5.
desc.ja: 武器の攻撃力を強化する。効果：攻撃力が５上昇する

desc.en: Effect: Increases power by 10 ÷ number of affected targets ％.
desc.ja: 効果：１０÷効果範囲の対象％、威力がアップする
